question: Find the user who has edited the most popular post (by view count) among all posts that have at least 1000 views and were created by users located in the United Kingdom. Return the editor's display name, website URL, and the total score of all posts they have ever edited that also have at least 1000 views.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS PostId, p.XCL_030 AS ViewCount, p.XCL_031 AS Score
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN users creator ON p.XCL_033 = creator.XCL_052
    WHERE p.XCL_030 >= 1000
      AND creator.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom'
),
top_editor AS (
    SELECT ph.XCL_017 AS EditorId
    FROM postHistory ph
    INNER JOIN qualifying_posts qp ON ph.XCL_014 = qp.PostId
    ORDER BY qp.ViewCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
total_score AS (
    SELECT ph.XCL_017 AS EditorId, SUM(p.XCL_031) AS TotalScore
    FROM postHistory ph
    INNER JOIN posts p ON ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE ph.XCL_017 = (SELECT EditorId FROM top_editor)
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 1000
    GROUP BY ph.XCL_017
)
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName, u.XCL_057 AS WebsiteUrl, ts.TotalScore
FROM users u
INNER JOIN top_editor te ON u.XCL_052 = te.EditorId
INNER JOIN total_score ts ON u.XCL_052 = ts.EditorId

    GROUP BY ph.XCL_017
)

)

LEFT JOIN edited_posts ep ON 1=1
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
